title: एकोनषष्ट्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 159 · The sleeping armies and the moon

summary.en: After Ghatotkacha's fall, Karna's night war leaves the Pandavas in grief, and the weary soldiers fall asleep where they stand. When the moon rises the fighting begins again for the slaughter of the world.
summary.kn: ಘಟೋತ್ಕಚನ ಪತನದ ನಂತರ ಪಾಂಡವರು ದುಃಖದಲ್ಲಿರಲು ದಣಿದ ಸೈನಿಕರು ನಿಂತಲ್ಲೇ ನಿದ್ರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಚಂದ್ರೋದಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಜಗದ ನಾಶಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಮತ್ತೆ ಯುದ್ಧ ಆರಂಭ.
summary.hi: घटोत्कच के पतन के बाद पाण्डव शोक में रहते हैं और थके सैनिक खड़े-खड़े सो जाते हैं। चन्द्रमा के उदय पर लोकनाश के लिए युद्ध फिर शुरू होता है।
summary.te: ఘటోత్కచుని పతనం తరువాత పాండవులు దుఃఖంలో ఉండగా అలసిన సైనికులు నిలిచిన చోటనే నిద్రపోతారు. చంద్రోదయంలో లోకనాశనం కోసం యుద్ధం మళ్లీ మొదలవుతుంది.
summary.ta: கடோத்கசனின் வீழ்ச்சிக்குப்பின் பாண்டவர் துயரில் இருக்க, களைத்த வீரர் நின்ற இடத்திலேயே உறங்குகின்றனர். சந்திரன் எழுந்ததும் உலகழிவுக்காகப் போர் மீண்டும் தொடங்குகிறது.
summary.ml: ഘടോൽക്കചന്റെ വീഴ്ചയ്ക്കുശേഷം കർണ്ണന്റെ രാത്രിയുദ്ധം പാണ്ഡവരെ ദുഃഖത്തിലാഴ്ത്തുന്നു; തളർന്ന സൈനികർ നിന്ന നിൽപ്പിൽ ഉറങ്ങിപ്പോകുന്നു. ചന്ദ്രനുദിക്കുമ്പോൾ ലോകത്തിന്റെ കൂട്ടക്കൊലയ്ക്കായി യുദ്ധം വീണ്ടും തുടങ്ങുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.159; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
घटोत्कचे तु निहते सूतपुत्रेण तां निशाम् ।
दुःखामर्षवशं प्राप्तो धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: When Ghatotkacha was slain that night by the charioteer's son, Yudhishthira, son of Dharma, fell under the sway of grief and anger.

verses.text:
दृष्ट्व भीमेन महतीं वार्यमाणां चमूं तव ।
धृष्टद्युम्नमुवाचेदं कुम्भयोनिं निवारय ॥

meaning.en: Seeing your great army held back by Bhima, he said to Dhrishtadyumna: Hold back Drona, born of a pot.

verses.text:
त्वं हि द्रोणविनाशाय समुत्पन्नो हुताशनात् ।
सशरः कवची खड्गी धन्वी च परतापनः ।
अभिद्रव रणे हृष्टो न च ते भीः कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: You were born from the fire for the destruction of Drona, with arrows, armor, sword and bow, a tormentor of enemies. Rush at him in the battle in high spirits, and have no fear at all.

verses.text:
जनमेजयः शिखण्डी च दौर्मुखिश्च यशोधनः ।
अभिद्रवन्तु संहृष्टाः कुम्भयोनिं समन्ततः ॥

meaning.en: Let Janamejaya, Shikhandi and glorious Daurmukhi, all joyful, rush at Drona on every side.

verses.text:
नकुलः सहदेवश्च द्रौपदेयाः प्रभद्रकाः ।
द्रुपदश्च विराटश्च पुत्रभ्रातृसमन्वितौ ॥

meaning.en: Let Nakula, Sahadeva, the sons of Draupadi and the Prabhadrakas, and Drupada and Virata, each with sons and brothers,

verses.text:
सात्यकिः केकयाश्चैव पाण्डवश्च धनंजयः ।
अभिद्रवन्तु वेगेन भारद्वाजवधेप्सया ॥

meaning.en: Satyaki, the Kekayas and Dhananjaya the Pandava rush with speed, desiring the death of Bharadvaja's son.

verses.text:
तथैव रथिनः सर्वे हस्त्यश्वं यच्च किंचन ।
पादाताश्च रणे द्रोणं प्रापयन्तु महारथम् ॥

meaning.en: So too let all the charioteers, and whatever elephants, horses and foot soldiers there are, bring the great chariot-warrior Drona into the battle.

verses.text:
तथाज्ञप्तास्तु ते सर्वे पाण्डवेन महात्मना ।
अभ्यद्रवन्त वेगेन कुम्भयोनिं युयुत्सया ॥

meaning.en: Thus commanded by the great-souled Pandava, they all rushed swiftly at Drona, eager to fight.

verses.text:
आगच्छतस्तान्सहसा सर्वोद्योगेन पाण्डवान् ।
प्रतिजग्राह समरे द्रोणः शस्त्रभृतां वरः ॥

meaning.en: As the Pandavas came on suddenly with all their effort, Drona, best of those who bear weapons, met them in the battle.

verses.text:
ततो दुर्योधनो राजा सर्वोद्योगेन पाण्डवान् ।
अभ्यद्रवत्सुसंक्रुद्ध इच्छन्द्रोणस्य जीवितम् ॥

meaning.en: Then King Duryodhana, very angry, rushed at the Pandavas with all his might, wishing to protect Drona's life.

verses.text:
ततः प्रववृते युद्धं श्रान्तवाहनसैनिकम् ।
पाण्डवानां कुरूणां च गर्जतामितरेतरम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the battle went on between the Pandavas and the Kurus, who bellowed at each other, with their mounts and soldiers weary.

verses.text:
निद्रान्धास्ते महाराज परिश्रान्ताश्च संयुगे ।
नाभ्यपद्यन्त समरे कांचिच्चेष्टां महारथाः ॥

meaning.en: Blind with sleep and worn out in the fight, O great king, those great chariot-warriors could make no movement in the battle.

verses.text:
त्रियामा रजनी चैषा घोररूपा भयानका ।
सहस्रयामप्रतिमा बभूव प्राणहारिणी ।
वध्यतां च तथा तेषां क्षतानां च विशेषतः ॥

meaning.en: That night of three watches was dreadful, fearsome, life-taking, like a thousand watches long, especially for those who were being killed and wounded.

verses.text:
अहो रात्रिः समाजज्ञे निद्रान्धानां विशेषतः ।
सर्वे ह्यासन्निरुत्साहाः क्षत्रिया दीनचेतसः ।
तव चैव परेषां च गतास्त्रा विगतेषवः ॥

meaning.en: The day and the night seemed to run together for those blind with sleep. All the kshatriyas on your side and the enemy's were spiritless and sad of heart, their weapons and arrows spent.

verses.text:
ते तथा पारयन्तश्च ह्रीमन्तश्च विशेषतः ।
स्वधर्ममनुपश्यन्तो न जहुः स्वामनीकिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: Yet, holding on, and being especially modest, and looking to their own duty, they did not abandon their own armies.

verses.text:
शस्त्राण्यन्ये समुत्सृज्य निद्रान्धाः शेरते जनाः ।
गजेष्वन्ये रथेष्वन्ये हयेष्वन्ये च भारत ॥

meaning.en: Others threw down their weapons and lay blind with sleep, some on elephants, some in chariots, some on horses, O Bharata.

verses.text:
निद्रान्धा नो बुबुधिरे कांचिच्चेष्टां नराधिपाः ।
तेऽन्योन्यं समरे योधाः प्रेषयन्त यमक्षयम् ॥

meaning.en: The kings, blind with sleep, were not aware of any action, and in the battle those warriors sent each other to Yama's abode.

verses.text:
स्वप्नायमानास्त्वपरे परानिति विचेतसः ।
आत्मानं समरे जघ्नुः स्वानेव च परानपि ॥

meaning.en: Others, dreaming and senseless, thinking they were striking foes, killed themselves or their own men as well as enemies.

verses.text:
नानावाचो विमुञ्चन्तो निद्रान्धास्ते महारणे ।
योद्धव्यमिति तिष्ठन्तो निद्रासंसक्तलोचनाः ॥

meaning.en: Blind with sleep in that great battle, they uttered all sorts of words, standing with eyes clinging to sleep, saying 'We must fight.'

verses.text:
संमर्द्यान्ये रणे केचिन्निद्रान्धाश्च परस्परम् ।
जघ्नुः शूरा रणे राजंस्तस्मिंस्तमसि दारुणे ॥

meaning.en: Some, crushing each other in the fight, blind with sleep, slew one another in that dreadful darkness, O king.

verses.text:
हन्यमानं तथात्मानं परेभ्यो बहवो जनाः ।
नाभ्यजानन्त समरे निद्रया मोहिता भृशम् ॥

meaning.en: Many men, struck down by others, did not know in the battle that they were being killed, so thoroughly deluded were they by sleep.

verses.text:
तेषामेतादृशीं चेष्टां विज्ञाय पुरुषर्षभः ।
उवाच वाक्यं बीभत्सुरुच्चैः संनादयन्दिशः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing how they behaved, Bibhatsu, the best of men, made all directions ring and spoke loudly.

verses.text:
श्रान्ता भवन्तो निद्रान्धाः सर्व एव सवाहनाः ।
तमसा चावृते सैन्ये रजसा बहुलेन च ॥

meaning.en: Arjuna said: You are all tired and blind with sleep, with your mounts, and the army is covered by darkness and thick dust.

verses.text:
ते यूयं यदि मन्यध्वमुपारमत सैनिकाः ।
निमीलयत चात्रैव रणभूमौ मुहूर्तकम् ॥

meaning.en: If you think fit, soldiers, then stop fighting and close your eyes for a moment right here on the battlefield.

verses.text:
ततो विनिद्रा विश्रान्ताश्चन्द्रमस्युदिते पुनः ।
संसाधयिष्यथान्योन्यं स्वर्गाय कुरुपाण्डवाः ॥

meaning.en: Then, awake and rested when the moon rises again, Kurus and Pandavas, you can send each other to heaven.

verses.text:
तद्वचः सर्वधर्मज्ञा धार्मिकस्य निशम्य ते ।
अरोचयन्त सैन्यानि तथा चान्योन्यमब्रुवन् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing the words of that righteous man, all those knowers of dharma among the armies approved and said so to each other.

verses.text:
चुक्रुशुः कर्ण कर्णेति राजन्दुर्योधनेति च ।
उपारमत पाण्डूनां विरता हि वरूथिनी ॥

meaning.en: They cried out 'Karna, Karna!' and 'Duryodhana!' saying 'Stop!' And the Pandava army had in fact stopped.

verses.text:
तथा विक्रोशमानस्य फल्गुनस्य ततस्ततः ।
उपारमत पाण्डूनां सेना तव च भारत ॥

meaning.en: As Phalguna thus called out here and there, the armies of the Pandavas and yours stopped, O Bharata.

verses.text:
तामस्य वाचं देवाश्च ऋषयश्च महात्मनः ।
सर्वसैन्यानि चाक्षुद्राः प्रहृष्टाः प्रत्यपूजयन् ॥

meaning.en: Gods and sages and all the armies, magnanimous and delighted, honored that speech of the great-souled one.

verses.text:
तत्संपूज्य वचोऽक्रूरं सर्वसैन्यानि भारत ।
मुहूर्तमस्वपन्राजञ्श्रान्तानि भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Honoring those gentle words, all the armies, O Bharata, tired as they were, slept for a moment, O best of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
सा तु संप्राप्य विश्रामं ध्वजिनी तव भारत ।
सुखमाप्तवती वीरमर्जुनं प्रत्यपूजयत् ॥

meaning.en: Having found rest, your army, O Bharata, was happy and praised the hero Arjuna.

verses.text:
त्वयि वेदास्तथास्त्राणि त्वयि बुद्धिपराक्रमौ ।
धर्मस्त्वयि महाबाहो दया भूतेषु चानघ ॥

meaning.en: 'In you are the Vedas and the weapons, in you wisdom and valor, in you dharma, mighty-armed one, and compassion for all beings, sinless one.

verses.text:
यच्चाश्वस्तास्तवेच्छामः शर्म पार्थ तदस्तु ते ।
मनसश्च प्रियानर्थान्वीर क्षिप्रमवाप्नुहि ॥

meaning.en: 'The comfort we have found in rest, Partha, let that be yours, and swiftly gain what your heart holds dear, hero.'

verses.text:
इति ते तं नरव्याघ्रं प्रशंसन्तो महारथाः ।
निद्रया समवाक्षिप्तास्तूष्णीमासन्विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: So those great chariot-warriors praised that tiger among men, and, overcome by sleep, fell silent, lord of the people.

verses.text:
अश्वपृष्ठेषु चाप्यन्ये रथनीडेषु चापरे ।
गजस्कन्धगताश्चान्ये शेरते चापरे क्षितौ ॥

meaning.en: Some slept on horses' backs, some in the seats of chariots, some on elephants' shoulders, and some on the ground.

verses.text:
सायुधाः सगदाश्चैव सखड्गाः सपरश्वधाः ।
सप्रासकवचाश्चान्ये नराः सुप्ताः पृथक्पृथक् ॥

meaning.en: Men slept apart from each other, with weapons, maces, swords, axes, lances and armor.

verses.text:
गजास्ते पन्नगाभोगैर्हस्तैर्भूरेणुरूषितैः ।
निद्रान्धा वसुधां चक्रुर्घ्राणनिःश्वासशीतलाम् ॥

meaning.en: The elephants, blind with sleep, with trunks coiled like serpents' bodies and smeared with dust, made the earth cool with the breath of their trunks.

verses.text:
गजाः शुशुभिरे तत्र निःश्वसन्तो महीतले ।
विशीर्णा गिरयो यद्वन्निःश्वसद्भिर्महोरगैः ॥

meaning.en: The elephants breathing on the ground looked like shattered mountains with great serpents breathing from them.

verses.text:
समां च विषमां चक्रुः खुराग्रैर्विक्षतां महीम् ।
हयाः काञ्चनयोक्त्राश्च केसरालम्बिभिर्युगैः ।
सुषुपुस्तत्र राजेन्द्र युक्ता वाहेषु सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: Horses with golden harness, with yokes resting against their manes, trampled the ground with the tips of their hooves, making it uneven or even, and slept there, O king of kings, still yoked all around.

verses.text:
तत्तथा निद्रया भग्नमवाचमस्वपद्बलम् ।
कुशलैरिव विन्यस्तं पटे चित्रमिवाद्भुतम् ॥

meaning.en: So that army, overcome by sleep, lay silent, like a wondrous picture arranged by skilled hands on a cloth.

verses.text:
ते क्षत्रियाः कुण्डलिनो युवानः
परस्परं सायकविक्षताङ्गाः ।
कुम्भेषु लीनाः सुषुपुर्गजानां
कुचेषु लग्ना इव कामिनीनाम् ॥

meaning.en: Those young kshatriyas with earrings, their limbs wounded by each other's arrows, slept hidden against the foreheads of elephants as if clinging to the breasts of lovers.

verses.text:
ततः कुमुदनाथेन कामिनीगण्डपाण्डुना ।
नेत्रानन्देन चन्द्रेण माहेन्द्री दिगलंकृता ॥

meaning.en: Then the eastern quarter of Indra was adorned by the moon, lord of the night lotus, pale as a lover's cheek, a delight to the eyes.

verses.text:
ततो मुहूर्ताद्भगवान्पुरस्ताच्छशलक्षणः ।
अरुणं दर्शयामास ग्रसञ्ज्योतिःप्रभं प्रभुः ॥

meaning.en: Then, after a moment, the divine moon, bearing the mark of the hare, appeared in the east, swallowing the glow of Aruna, the dawn's light.

verses.text:
अरुणस्य तु तस्यानु जातरूपसमप्रभम् ।
रश्मिजालं महच्चन्द्रो मन्दं मन्दमवासृजत् ॥

meaning.en: After Aruna, the moon slowly sent out a great net of rays, with a radiance like gold.

verses.text:
उत्सारयन्तः प्रभया तमस्ते चन्द्ररश्मयः ।
पर्यगच्छञ्शनैः सर्वा दिशः खं च क्षितिं तथा ॥

meaning.en: Those moonbeams, driving away the dark with their light, slowly spread over all directions, the sky and the earth.

verses.text:
ततो मुहूर्ताद्भुवनं ज्योतिर्भूतमिवाभवत् ।
अप्रख्यमप्रकाशं च जगामाशु तमस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Then after a moment the world seemed made of light, and the darkness quickly went away, unseen and unnoticed.

verses.text:
प्रतिप्रकाशिते लोके दिवाभूते निशाकरे ।
विचेरुर्न विचेरुश्च राजन्नक्तंचरास्ततः ॥

meaning.en: When the world was lit again and the night-maker had made it like day, the night-prowlers, O king, moved about and did not move about.

verses.text:
बोध्यमानं तु तत्सैन्यं राजंश्चन्द्रस्य रश्मिभिः ।
बुबुधे शतपत्राणां वनं महदिवाम्भसि ॥

meaning.en: The army, awakened by the moon's rays, O king, woke like a great bed of lotuses on the water.

verses.text:
यथा चन्द्रोदयोद्धूतः क्षुभितः सागरो भवेत् ।
तथा चन्द्रोदयोद्धूतः स बभूव बलार्णवः ॥

meaning.en: As the sea is stirred and heaved by the rising of the moon, so that ocean of troops was stirred by the moonrise.

verses.text:
ततः प्रववृते युद्धं पुनरेव विशां पते ।
लोके लोकविनाशाय परं लोकमभीप्सताम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the battle began again, lord of the people, for the destruction of the world, among men who desired the other world.
